subject: mercedes-sinclair
q: CLOSED — AGAIN MEANT SHE DID. All forty-four of them, at her own adoption, and that was the last time anyone tried it.
detail:
THE FIRST READING WAS RIGHT, AND ONE FLAGGED WORD TURNED OUT TO BE A WHOLE ARC.

MERCEDES SPEED-RAN ALL FORTY-FOUR MEMBERS OF THE FOUND FAMILY AT THE TIME OF HER ADOPTION, AND IT WAS THE LAST TIME THEY TRIED THE POLY THING.

AND HER OWN INDEX ENTRY PROVES THE NUMBER. SHE IS GREMLINDEX 45. ADOPTED ARC 11. FORTY-FOUR MEMBERS, AND THE FORTY-FIFTH WOMAN WENT THROUGH ALL OF THEM. The count in the story is her number minus one, and nothing was arranged to make that work.

THE RESOLUTION WAS MATCHMAKING AND NOT A RULE. She told Selene and Viraena THE SPECS OF HER IDEAL PARTNER. They handed those specs to SOMEBODY WHO WANTED ALL OF MERCEDES and said GO, YOUR PREY IS WAITING. She went. That woman is DAKOTA BELLAMY, and Mercedes went FROM ANY AND ALL COCKS TO DAKOTA’S COCK AS OFTEN AS POSSIBLE.

SO THE ARCHIVE’S CAUTION WAS CORRECTLY PLACED AND FOR THE WRONG REASON. It worried that inventing a past for Mercedes would write history onto unnamed women. THE HISTORY INVOLVES FORTY-FOUR WOMEN, ALL OF WHOM ARE NAMED SOMEWHERE IN THIS ARCHIVE. Guessing the gentler reading would not have protected anybody. IT WOULD JUST HAVE ERASED THE LARGEST SINGLE EVENT IN THE COMPOUND’S SEXUAL HISTORY.

AND IT RECASTS THE MONOGAMY LAW ENTIRELY: IT WAS NOT IMPOSED, IT WAS ARRIVED AT. The most comprehensively non-monogamous woman in the family’s history tested the alternative to exhaustion, was pointed at one woman who wanted all of her, AND HAS NOT LOOKED SIDEWAYS SINCE. See c-the-poly-attempt.
